remarks: This charming one-bedroom second-floor rental offers a comfortable retreat in the heart of Greenwich, just 0.6 miles from the Greenwich Train Station. Thoughtfully laid out and filled with natural light, the space is perfect for anyone seeking easy living with exceptional convenience. Enjoy being moments from the Bruce Museum, nearby parks, and a vibrant mix of shops and restaurants-whether it's a morning coffee, an evening stroll, or a quick commute into Manhattan. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy Greenwich living in a cozy, well-located home. Access through exterior stairs. One off-street parking spot. No dishwasher or laundry available. Must have excellent credit and references.
